column2: Turn the owner's own words into a clear, approved intent.md (define session, planner model)
Finish a define session: validate the spec, write BUILD_PROMPT.md, get approval, merge docs, queue the build session
Start or resume a session (queued build, active, or in-review)
Append a resumable checkpoint to the active session's STATE.md
Take a finished build through verify, PR, judge, final check, merge and tag, UAT, (prod), close
Promote a UAT-tested release to prod: the releaser decides from UAT evidence; fails closed
Close the active session: complete, roll over leftover work, park in-review, or abandon
List open sessions and flag anything out of sync (read-only)
